title: Traditional British Scotch Egg
description: A nostalgic egg dish from the UK, featuring a runny egg yolk coated in a mixture of nutty breadcrumbs and spices, then deep-fried to perfection. Serve warm for an indulgent treat.
instructions: Start by making the breadcrumbs by blending the toasted bread into fine crumbs.
Add the panko breadcrumbs, miso paste, mirin, salt, and black pepper to the breadcrumbs and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the egg yolks to the breadcrumbs mixture and stir until just combined.
Dust the egg yolks with flour, then coat in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Carefully place the egg yolk-coated mixture into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the Scotch egg on paper towels and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
